wrong_alternatives.wrong_rule: Copy the SPM threshold into an applicable SLA instead of using its independently configured section override.
wrong_alternatives.evidence_basis: The retained section SLA writer upserts m_sla by section_id and spm_id; the effective view uses those source rows independently from m_spm.
wrong_alternatives.construction: Set the event's applicable code-1 SLA threshold equal to its SPM threshold and recompute the full T7 output.

wrong_alternatives.wrong_rule: Select an event by section, date, and shift while ignoring the requested gate.
wrong_alternatives.evidence_basis: The routine writer permits one report per dated schedule and gate, so a different gate may report on the same section/date/shift.
wrong_alternatives.construction: Evaluate the same-date, same-shift Sungai Pinang report as the requested Bangkinang event.

wrong_alternatives.evidence_basis: The retained section SLA writer updates m_sla independently and the effective view resolves the SLA fields from that row.
wrong_alternatives.construction: Copy code-3 SPM's 9-second threshold to the applicable SLA, then recompute all T8 rows.

semantic_branches: two distinct routine reports contribute in each period
each period status fails when any report/booth evaluation fails
SPM and independently overridden SLA both deteriorate from pass to fail

wrong_alternatives.wrong_rule: Use only the first routine report in each requested period instead of aggregating every scoped report.
wrong_alternatives.evidence_basis: Routine capture permits reports on distinct dated schedules; the reviewed recap/trend semantics aggregate observations over the requested period.
wrong_alternatives.construction: Recompute each period from its earliest report only.

wrong_alternatives.wrong_rule: Aggregate the period-wide mean of rounded report/booth means, then apply it independently to SPM and applicable SLA across all period evaluations, allowing passing observations to offset failing observations.
wrong_alternatives.evidence_basis: The reviewed SPM/SLA business reference defines period status as fail when any report/booth evaluation fails.
wrong_alternatives.construction: For each requested period, average non-null ordinary-booth samples within each scoped report/booth and round each evaluation mean to hundredths; take an equally weighted mean of those evaluations and round it to hundredths. Compare that one period mean independently with each effective SPM threshold and each applicable effective SLA threshold, applying the result to every observed evaluation slot (failed count is zero or the evaluation count). Keep non-applicable SLA count/status at zero/not_applicable and recompute both transitions.

wrong_alternatives.wrong_rule: Use the SPM threshold for the applicable SLA rather than the independent section override.
wrong_alternatives.evidence_basis: The retained section SLA writer persists the target in m_sla, independently of m_spm; the effective view derives the two values separately.
wrong_alternatives.construction: Copy code-1 SPM's 6-second threshold to SLA and recompute the full two-period output.
